subtitle: Learn how guitar techniques adapt and evolve when using effects. Master the relationship between playing style and sonic processing.

introduction.title: Effects & Technique Synergy
introduction.text: Effects pedals are not mere tone polishers; they fundamentally reshape how physical guitar technique translates into audio. From tightening pick attacks when running through high-gain compression to locking delay repeats to rhythmic subdivisions and modulating pick dynamics through envelope filters, mastering effect integration makes processing an organic extension of your hands.

columns.title: Technique Adaptation
columns.text: Effects change how your playing translates to sound. Learn to adapt your technique to work with, rather than against, your effects.

columns.title: Musical Context
columns.text: Different genres and songs require specific effect/technique combinations to achieve authentic sounds and expressions.
